decision: The complete two-file/six-hunk patch is adapted in the owned legacy trigger. Its supplied public view injector resolves the nondeprecated public BreakpointObserver at the advertised CDK 21.2.14 minimum while retaining the historical eleven-argument constructor. One fixed HandsetLandscape subscription is created before first overlay attachment and reused across close/reopen. It sets flexible dimensions/growth/margin to true/true/8 in landscape and false/false/0 otherwise, and teardown unsubscribes without completing the borrowed observer. The original comment adds no behavior. The sole upstream MDC spec offset change does not replace the legacy75px selector/geometry assertion. Five exact existing native tests are mandatory in the complete same-run packed/historical suite. Current source-protocol/lifetime diagnostics and corruption controls support this source decision; actual Angular geometry, artifact behavior and runtime/peer floors require their separate executions. No product API, HTML, CSS or SCSS change is required.
